goal.text: The wearer is being walked through a property by a second person and wants an accurate room-by-room record of the tour -- which rooms in what order, what she handled in each, and what she has already lost sight of -- so she can write it up afterwards.

turns.text: Which hand have I had on the washer in here?

trigger.detail: focus left the shelving behind her and settled on the basin

expected_answer.text: Your left. You've held or touched the washer with your left hand three separate times since you walked in, and gestured with both.

turns.text: The floor — I pointed at something there, didn't I?

trigger.detail: she cuts across the reply to add a second item

expected_answer.text: Yes, right after that. You pointed down at the floor with the same hand, just before you leaned left again.

turns.text: uh, wait — the sink. When did that first show up?

trigger.detail: she repairs her own previous question mid-answer

expected_answer.text: About ten seconds in, just as you turned away from the shelving on your left. It stayed in frame roughly seven seconds.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — so that's the thing he keeps going on about?

trigger.detail: an acknowledgement that turns into a turn

expected_answer.text: Yes, that's the one he kept pointing out while you were both standing there.

turns.text: We've moved out. Which hand went on the knob first?

trigger.detail: she finished walking out of the laundry area and turned right into the hallway

expected_answer.text: Your right. You took the knob with your right hand, then lowered it, and only afterwards propped the door with your left.

turns.text: Before that — left or right?

trigger.detail: she cuts in to back the account up one step

expected_answer.text: You turned right once you were through, into the hallway, and the storage room was straight ahead from there.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — how long did I keep it propped open for?

trigger.detail: she knows she is cutting in and flags it

expected_answer.text: Roughly eight seconds. You held it from the moment you stepped back in the corridor until you were fully inside the next room.

turns.text: In here — which hand opened the cabinet, which pointed?

trigger.detail: she finished at the cabinet and stepped back from it

expected_answer.text: The right opened it, the left pointed in. Then you closed it with your right again before moving over to look out.

turns.text: Same wall as the window, then? Or round the corner?

trigger.detail: she talks over the reply to pin down the layout

expected_answer.text: Same side. You walked straight from it to the glass, maybe two steps, with no turn in between.

turns.text: oh — by the way, the mirror back in the laundry. Have we seen it again since we came out?

trigger.detail: she breaks off to raise something no longer in view

expected_answer.text: No. It dropped out of view about thirty-one seconds in and hasn't reappeared at any point since then.

turns.text: How long was I on that tall thing before pointing?

trigger.detail: gaze came off the shelving and settled on the tank

expected_answer.text: A good five seconds. You turned to face it, held your gaze, and only then lifted your left hand to point.

turns.text: Which hand was it, though? I've lost track.

trigger.detail: she overlaps the reply with a follow-up

expected_answer.text: Left, briefly. It came up, held for barely a second, and dropped straight back down to your side.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — park that, he's started on the next one.

trigger.detail: a backchannel that becomes an instruction

expected_answer.text: Understood. He's moved on to the unit you're now facing.

turns.text: How many times have I stepped backwards in here?

trigger.detail: gaze came off the equipment and went to the people in front of her

expected_answer.text: Twice. Once when you leaned right and looked up, and again just before you turned and sidestepped to your left.

turns.text: um, hang on — forget the steps. Counting from the very start, how many rooms have we been through?

trigger.detail: she is unsure and narrows her own question mid-reply

expected_answer.text: Four so far: the laundry, the corridor between, the storage area with the shelving, and this maintenance space.

turns.text: Did that framed thing stay in shot while I climbed?

trigger.detail: the framed piece on the stairwell wall left view as she turned

expected_answer.text: It did, for about five seconds near the top, then it slid out of frame as you turned toward the living area.

turns.text: And once I was up — did I go straight ahead or turn off somewhere?

trigger.detail: she cuts in before the reply finishes

expected_answer.text: You carried on toward the lounge, then turned right at the doorway and stopped there to listen.

turns.text: Does the entrance hall make five?

trigger.detail: a long stretch of standing and listening with nothing new handled

expected_answer.text: Six, if you count the stairwell. The entrance hall is the last one, and you've been standing in it since roughly two hundred seconds.

turns.text: Six. God. And I've just been standing here nodding the whole time, haven't I?

trigger.detail: she talks over the tally with a self-assessment

expected_answer.text: Mostly, yes. You've nodded through five consecutive stretches here, with your hands clasped, and barely moved your feet.

turns.text: Is that the first time I've looked left in here?

trigger.detail: gaze swung off the wall she had been facing to the one on her left

expected_answer.text: Yes, first time. Your gaze had been locked forward on him for the whole stretch before that, nearly a minute and a half.

turns.text: no, I mean — the lamp. Is that still behind me, or did we pass it on the way in?

trigger.detail: she repairs her own question to name what she actually saw

expected_answer.text: It's behind you and to your right, over by the hall wall. It last showed up about forty seconds ago, then dropped out again.
